result.instructions: Tools for Timeero, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is clocked in right now, and to which job?"; "List last week's timesheets for the Riverside job and show the total hours per employee."; "Which timesheets from yesterday are still unapproved?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Timeero data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timeero_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timeero_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timeero_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. timeero_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timeero_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List employees (users) with role, active status, pay settings and custom fields. Filter by search text, role (1 Admin, 2 Manager, 3 Employee), group or active status. Timeero API: GET /api/public/users.

search.description: Search by first name, last name, group name, phone or email.

group_id.description: Only users in this group id.

active.description: true for active users, false for inactive.

tools.name: timeero_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id, including role, active status and custom fields. Timeero API: GET /api/public/users/{id}.

tools.name: timeero_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the groups (teams) of the company, optionally filtered by name. Timeero API: GET /api/public/groups.

sort.description: Sort field as the API defines it (e.g. name).

tools.name: timeero_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (projects or sites) with their status. Filter by name or active status. Timeero API: GET /api/public/jobs.

job_status.description: true for active jobs, false for inactive.

tools.name: timeero_get_job
tools.title: Get a job
tools.description: Get one job by id, including its geofence settings and custom fields. Timeero API: GET /api/public/jobs/{id}.

tools.name: timeero_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks, optionally for one job. Filter by name or active status. Timeero API: GET /api/public/tasks.

job_id.description: Only tasks under this job id.

task_status.description: true for active tasks, false for inactive.

tools.name: timeero_list_timesheets
tools.title: List timesheets
tools.description: List timesheet entries (clock-in to clock-out records). Filter by user, group, job, approval status or a date range. Timeero API: GET /api/public/timesheets.

group_id.description: Only timesheets of users in this group.

approved.description: true for approved, false for unapproved.

tools.name: timeero_get_timesheet
tools.title: Get a timesheet
tools.description: Get one timesheet entry by id, with clock times, breaks, mileage and approval state. Timeero API: GET /api/public/timesheets/{id}.

tools.name: timeero_get_timesheet_locations
tools.title: Get timesheet GPS locations
tools.description: Get the GPS points recorded for one timesheet. Timeero API: GET /api/public/locations/{timesheetId}.

tools.name: timeero_list_working_users
tools.title: List users working now
tools.description: List the users who are clocked in right now, with their job and location. Timeero API: GET /api/public/working-locations.

tools.name: timeero_list_breaks
tools.title: List breaks
tools.description: List timesheet breaks, optionally only the given break ids. Timeero API: GET /api/public/breaks.

tools.name: timeero_list_time_offs
tools.title: List time off
tools.description: List time-off entries that start within a date range, optionally for one user. Timeero API: GET /api/public/timeoffs.

tools.name: timeero_list_schedules
tools.title: List schedules
tools.description: List planned shifts (schedules) in a date range, optionally for one job, employee or status (draft or published). Timeero API: GET /api/public/schedules.

employee_id.description: Only schedules for this employee (user) id.

tools.name: timeero_get_schedule
tools.title: Get a schedule
tools.description: Get one schedule (planned shift) by id. Timeero API: GET /api/public/schedules/{id}.

tools.name: timeero_clock_in
tools.title: Clock a user in
tools.description: WRITE: start a timesheet for a user now or at a given time. Creates a live time record that payroll can use. Some companies require job_id. Timeero API: POST /api/public/timesheets/clock-in.

clock_in_time.description: Local date and time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-26T08:00:00.

job_id.description: Job id as a string, when the company requires a job.

task_id.description: Task id as a string, or null.

tools.name: timeero_clock_out
tools.title: Clock a user out
tools.description: WRITE: end the user's open timesheet at a given time. The clock-out time must be later than the clock-in time. Timeero API: POST /api/public/timesheets/clock-out.

clock_out_time.description: Local date and time of clock-out, later than the clock-in, e.g. 2026-11-26T17:00:00.

latitude.description: Latitude, as a number or string.

longitude.description: Longitude, as a number or string.

tools.name: timeero_approve_timesheets
tools.title: Approve timesheets
tools.description: WRITE: approve one or more timesheets by id. Approved time is locked for payroll. Reversible with timeero_unapprove_timesheets. Timeero API: POST /api/public/timesheets/approve.

mute_notification.description: true to skip the user notification.

tools.name: timeero_unapprove_timesheets
tools.title: Unapprove timesheets
tools.description: WRITE: remove the approval from one or more timesheets by id, so they can be edited again. Timeero API: POST /api/public/timesheets/unapprove.

mute_notification.description: true to skip the user notification.

prompts.description: What you can do with Timeero here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: see_who_is_working_now
prompts.title: See who is working now
prompts.description: List the users who are clocked in right now, with their job and location. Read the groups and jobs for context.

prompts.name: review_timesheets_and_breaks
prompts.title: Review timesheets and breaks
prompts.description: List timesheets by user, group, job, approval status or date range. Open one timesheet for clock times, breaks and mileage.

prompts.name: check_gps_points_of_a_timesheet
prompts.title: Check GPS points of a timesheet
prompts.description: Read the GPS points recorded for one timesheet, next to its clock times.

prompts.name: read_the_planned_schedule
prompts.title: Read the planned schedule
prompts.description: List planned shifts in a date range, filtered by job, employee or draft or published status. Open one schedule by id.

prompts.name: clock_users_in_or_out
prompts.title: Clock users in or out
prompts.description: Start a timesheet for a user now or at a given time, or end the open timesheet. The records can be used for payroll.

prompts.name: approve_or_unapprove_timesheets
prompts.title: Approve or unapprove timesheets
prompts.description: Approve timesheets by id, which locks the time for payroll. Remove the approval so the timesheets can be edited again.
